liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing in the Band** (3 reviews): Playin' > Scarlet Begonias > Playin' sandwich goes through jazz-funk territory; reviewer wonders if it is the only such sandwich; Playin' > Scarlet > Playin' takes off into must-hear territory according to the reviewer [13][14][18]
- **Eyes of the World** (2 reviews): Long, well-jammed first-set Eyes that reviewer ranks among the best of the year; Reviewer was surprised by a first-set Eyes and thought the first set outdid the second [13][18]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer describes the first-set Sugaree as intense [14]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer finds this Deal particularly hot, the best they have heard [15]
- **Seastones (Phil & Ned)** (1 review): Reviewer's first exposure to the band in 1974 was this show, and Seastones blew their mind [10]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone>Truckin>Spanish>Other One jam is very strong, though not the reviewer's favorite for 1974 [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **Fireworks**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-08-06.126356.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 246 min; rated 3.73/5 by 15 [1]
- **gd74-08-06.sbd.deadlists.1463.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 229 min; rated 4.77/5 by 30 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard one of the best sounding shows they have, with Phil's bass thick, sharp and prominent; Reviewer calls the soundboard sound quality excellent [14][15]
- **gd1974-08-06.166779.sbd.anon.gems.flac1644**: soundboard; 29 songs; 236 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [5]
- **gd74-08-06.merin.weiner.gdADT.5914.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 30 songs; 240 min; rated 4.27/5 by 66 [2]

## Around the show

- Stage comment between Bertha and Mexicali Blues concerns the previous day's release of the 'smoking gun' tape, not Nixon's resignation, which came August 8 [15]
- Show was a makeup for a date a few days earlier that was hit by a storm; entry required only a ticket stub [16]
- Most stubs were unreadable from rain, and some fans soaked old stubs to match, so attendance was reportedly about double [16]
- Reviewer says the news mentioned in the first set was Nixon's resignation, though they are unsure of the date [17]
- Ned Lagin played electric piano and synthesizer on Seastones [5]
- Eyes, Playin'>Scarlet>Playin' from this show appear on Dicks Picks 31 [10]
- Reviewer says the fourth disc of this audience recording is among the best Dead you will hear [11]
- Reviewer says few 80s or 90s shows have jamming this good even in a second set, let alone a first [13]
- Only Eyes, Playin>Scarlet>Playin, and Uncle John's Band from this show were released on Dicks Picks 31 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-08-06.126356.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:1463) MR > DAT > CD > Sonic Solutions > CD Circulation > Plextor SCSI 40x Reader > EAC and Audience (shnid:5914)… [1]. Also: This matrix recording by Dusborne is in FLAC 16-bit with show information embedded in each file's header [1]
- **gd74-08-06.sbd.deadlists.1463.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer says gdlive.com offers the same copy of the show as the audience recording on the Archive [20]
- **gd1974-08-06.166779.sbd.anon.gems.flac1644**: taped by Anon; transferred by Transferred and mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Minor repairs, track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Master reel > DAT (via Anon) [5]. Also: Source 135847 (Cooper/Berger) patches Eyes of the World, and source 5914 (Merin/Weiner) patches Truckin'; Soundboard transfer aired on KXCI Tucson's Dead Air on October 1, 2023, and was shared January 15, 2024 [5]
- **gd74-08-06.merin.weiner.gdADT.5914.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Neil Merin; source: Audience Recording [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Roosevelt Stadium - August 6, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/august-6-1974) [23]
- Poster by @linernotesblog: [Grateful Dead Monthly: Roosevelt Stadium – Jersey City, NJ 8/6/74](https://linernotesmusicblog.wordpress.com/2017/08/04/grateful-dead-monthly-roosevelt-stadium-jersey-city-nj-8674/) [24]
